title: Group 2 Powered Mattress (E0277) Criteria Schedule for Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces
content:
For Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces, the Group 2 powered pressure-reducing mattress is scheduled against each bed class with seven values: whether a Group 2 powered mattress may be furnished with the class; the code of the Group 2 powered pressure-reducing mattress; its fee-schedule rental for months 1 through 3 and from month 4 on (US dollars per month); the lowest pressure-ulcer stage (multiple ulcers on trunk or pelvis) that qualifies for the E0277 surface; the months on a Group 1 surface with a comprehensive ulcer program that must precede the E0277 surface when qualifying on stage 2 ulcers; and the interval, in months, at which continued need for the E0277 surface must be documented.

| Bed class | Group 2 powered mattress may be furnished with the class | Surface code | Surface rental, months 1 through 3 | Surface rental, month 4 on | Lowest qualifying ulcer stage | Prior Group 1 months | Documentation interval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | Yes | E0277 | $520.00 | $390.00 | stage 2 | 1 month | every 1 month |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | Yes | E0277 | $520.00 | $390.00 | stage 2 | 1 month | every 1 month |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | Yes | E0277 | $520.00 | $390.00 | stage 2 | 1 month | every 1 month |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | Yes | E0277 | $520.00 | $390.00 | stage 2 | 1 month | every 1 month |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | Yes | E0277 | $520.00 | $390.00 | stage 2 | 1 month | every 1 month |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | Yes | E0277 | $520.00 | $390.00 | stage 2 | 1 month | every 1 month |

## Schedule notes

- The schedule is uniform across the six bed classes: every class permits the surface, the surface is coded E0277 with every class, and its rental, stage, prior-trial and documentation values do not change with the bed class.
- The surface's two rental columns are monthly fee-schedule amounts, separate from the bed's own rental. A surface month numbered 1, 2 or 3 reads $520.00; a surface month numbered 4 or higher reads $390.00.
- The stage value is the lowest pressure-ulcer stage, for multiple ulcers on the trunk or pelvis, that qualifies for the E0277 surface: stage 2.
- The prior Group 1 value is 1 month on a Group 1 surface with a comprehensive ulcer program, the period that must precede the E0277 surface when qualifying on stage 2 ulcers.
- Continued need for the E0277 surface must be documented every 1 month.
